backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing user-scoped CRUD operations for prompts and categories with authorization checks, user profile management, and access control integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two completed features related to modifying the category filter bar to use a responsive grid layout that displays all categories without horizontal overflow.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend source files including stores, utilities, components, and features for prompts, categories, authentication, and backend synchronization.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Deployment troubleshooting guide providing structured steps for diagnosing build failures, capturing error logs, and resolving common TypeScript, build, and runtime issues.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme color schemes for UI components including sidebar, charts, and semantic colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with favicon links, viewport meta tags, and script reference to the React application's main TypeScript entry file.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component orchestrating authentication, backend sync, prompt/category management, view modes, filtering, sorting, and UI state with Internet Identity integration and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/SignInScree: Dedicated sign-in screen component displaying a centered card with branding and Internet Identity login button for unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/components/backend/BackendC: Alert banner component displaying backend connection status with loading spinner during initialization and error messages with reload button on connection failure.
frontend/src/components/categories/Categ: Renders a horizontal filter bar with category badges, favorites toggle, and create/rename/delete category actions. Includes dialogs for category management and uses paste handlers for text inputs.
Provides a checkbox list for selecting multiple categories with an input to create new categories. Validates for duplicate category names (case-insensitive) and syncs with backend.
frontend/src/components/categories/Manag: Dialog for renaming and deleting categories with inline editing UI and usage count display. Validates for duplicates and confirms deletion with prompt count information.
frontend/src/components/importExport/Imp: Provides export and import buttons for prompts and categories as JSON files. Handles file upload, validation, and syncs imported data to backend.
frontend/src/components/prompts/ConfirmD: Reusable confirmation dialog component wrapping AlertDialog with customizable title, description, and confirm action.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptAc: Action button toolbar for prompts with copy, favorite, duplicate, edit, and delete operations. Uses tooltips and shows visual feedback for copy action.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptCo: Renders sanitized HTML content for prompts with proper whitespace handling using dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptEd: Modal dialog for creating and editing prompts with title input, rich text editor, and category picker. Handles save state, validation, and backend status messages.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptGr: Renders prompts in a responsive grid layout with cards showing title, categories (up to 3 visible), truncated content, and action buttons for edit/delete/duplicate/favorite operations.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptLi: Displays prompts in a vertical list of cards with full title, all categories, complete content, and action buttons positioned in the header.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptPr: Modal dialog component that displays a prompt's full title and content in a scrollable overlay when opened.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptTa: Renders prompts in a table with columns for title, categories, modified date, and actions; clicking a row opens a preview dialog.
frontend/src/components/search/SearchInp: Search input component with a search icon that filters prompts by title, content, or category, and includes custom paste handling for clean text input.
frontend/src/components/sorting/SortDrop: Dropdown select component for changing prompt sort order with options including date added, alphabetical, recently edited, and favorites first.
frontend/src/components/views/ViewModeTo: Toggle button group with three view mode options (list, grid, table) represented by icons, highlighting the currently active view.
frontend/src/features/auth/iiProviderLog: Utility functions for performing full-page Internet Identity logout by navigating to the II logout endpoint with a return URL, including domain validation and blocked domain filtering.
frontend/src/features/auth/logoutReturnU: Builds the post-logout return URL with a hardcoded caffeineAdminToken hash fragment for redirecting users back to the app after Internet Identity logout.
frontend/src/features/auth/useReliableII: React hook that orchestrates a two-phase logout: first clears local auth state, waits for identity to become anonymous, then performs full-page provider logout navigation.
frontend/src/features/backend/actorDiagn: Diagnostic logging utilities for backend actor creation and connectivity issues, providing structured error context for debugging production failures.
frontend/src/features/backend/promptLibr: API layer that maps between frontend Prompt/Category types and backend types, providing methods for CRUD operations on prompts and categories via the backend actor interface.
frontend/src/features/backend/useBackend: React hook that monitors backend actor creation status, provides structured diagnostics when actor initialization fails, and returns loading/ready/error states with user-friendly status messages.
frontend/src/features/backend/usePromptL: React hook that syncs prompt library data with the backend after authentication, performs connectivity checks, loads prompts/categories from backend, and merges with local favorites state.
frontend/src/features/categories/categor: Zustand store managing category state with case-insensitive duplicate prevention and methods for adding, renaming, deleting, and bulk setting categories.
frontend/src/features/clipboard/useCopyT: React hook providing clipboard copy functionality with modern API and fallback support, returning copy function and temporary copied state indicator.
frontend/src/features/importExport/expor: Exports prompts and categories to a JSON file with versioning and timestamp, triggering browser download.
frontend/src/features/importExport/impor: Imports prompts from JSON file, validates format, handles ID collisions by generating new IDs, and returns prompts/categories or error message.
frontend/src/features/importExport/schem: Defines ExportData interface and validation function to ensure imported JSON contains properly structured prompts and categories.
frontend/src/features/paste/cleanPastedT: Cleans pasted text from Word and other sources by removing HTML/CSS artifacts, normalizing whitespace, and preserving basic structure like line breaks and list formatting.
frontend/src/features/paste/cleanPasteHa: Creates paste event handlers for input/textarea and contentEditable elements that clean pasted content and insert it at cursor position while preserving line breaks.
Filters prompts by search query (case-insensitive across title/content/categories), selected category, and favorites-only flag.
frontend/src/features/prompts/id.ts: Generates unique prompt IDs using timestamp and random string combination.
frontend/src/features/prompts/promptStor: Zustand store managing prompt state with CRUD operations, favorites toggling, category management, and bulk operations for syncing with backend.
frontend/src/features/prompts/sorting.ts: Sorts prompts by various modes including date added, alphabetical, recently edited, and favorites first.
frontend/src/features/prompts/types.ts: Defines TypeScript types for the prompt library including Prompt interface with metadata fields, ViewMode for display options (list/grid/table), and SortMode for various sorting strategies.
frontend/src/features/richText/htmlToPla: Utility function that converts HTML to plain text by stripping all tags, decoding entities, and collapsing whitespace using DOM parsing.
frontend/src/features/richText/sanitizeH: Sanitizes HTML by recursively cleaning DOM nodes to allow only safe formatting tags (bold, italic, color spans), converting font tags to spans, and dropping unsafe elements like scripts and styles.
frontend/src/features/richText/SimpleRic: React component providing a contentEditable-based rich text editor with toolbar for bold, italic, and color formatting, using document.execCommand and integrated paste cleaning handlers.
frontend/src/features/storage/localStora: Provides functions to load and save UI preferences (viewMode) to localStorage with error handling.
frontend/src/features/storage/useAutoPer: React hook that persists viewMode UI preference to localStorage on mount and changes, while prompts/categories are handled separately by backend sync.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook using TanStack Query to create and manage an authenticated or anonymous backend actor based on Internet Identity, with automatic query invalidation on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme colors using OKLCH color space for consistent design tokens.
frontend/src/lib/favicon.ts: Deprecated no-op function kept for backwards compatibility; favicon is now set via static link tags in index.html.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup capabilities for sensitive parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system with CSS variables, custom animations for accordions, font families (Inter and JetBrains Mono), and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state file for a Prompt Library app that stores and organizes prompts by categories with search, favorites, and category management features. Tracks architectural notes about responsive grid layout for categories and pending feature requests.
